articles.title: OnEMI Tech IPO subscribed 60% on day 2
articles.summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Ltd's initial public offering saw 60 percent subscription on its second day. The digital lending platform Kissht has already raised Rs 278 crore from anchor investors. The Rs 926 crore issue is open for bidding until May 5. The company aims to strengthen its subsidiary's capital base. Shares will be listed on BSE and NSE.

articles.title: InGovern asks directors of 7 listed Tata firms to push for listing of Tata Sons
articles.summary: InGovern Research Services urged directors of seven listed Tata Group firms to advocate for Tata Sons' public listing. Citing RBI's 2026 regulatory shifts, the firm stressed the fiduciary duty to protect public shareholders by demanding a listing roadmap, market-linked valuation, and governance reforms.

articles.title: NCLAT dismisses Vedanta plea against Adani’s Jaiprakash Associates bid, upholds NCLT order
articles.summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal has dismissed Vedanta's challenges against Adani Enterprises' winning bid for Jaiprakash Associates. The tribunal upheld the National Company Law Tribunal's approval of Adani's resolution plan. Creditors chose Adani's offer based on multiple factors beyond just the highest bid.

articles.title: In major escalation, Tata Trusts to review its representation on Tata Sons’ board
articles.summary: Tata Trusts, the majority owner of Tata Sons, will review its board representation at a May 8 meeting amid internal differences over the group’s future direction. The move could lead to an attempt to remove vice chairman Venu Srinivasan from the Tata Sons board.

articles.title: SIS Ltd eyes Rs 20,000 crore revenue in FY27; targets 5 lakh workforce by 2030
articles.summary: SIS Ltd targets Rs 20,000 crore revenue by FY27. The security and facility management firm anticipates strong growth fueled by network expansion and new labour codes. The company is also embracing AI for enhanced customer service and operational efficiency. SIS plans to increase its workforce significantly by 2030.

articles.title: CCI rejects AGI Greenpac plea on INSCO green channel nod for HNG deal
articles.summary: The Competition Commission of India has once again rejected AGI Greenpac's challenge. The regulator upheld the green channel approval for Independent Sugar Corporation's acquisition of Hindusthan National Glass & Industries. AGI Greenpac's concerns about undisclosed equity participants and control transfer were dismissed. The CCI found no significant market overlaps or material changes warranting interference with the approval.

articles.title: Coforge closes acquisition of Cigniti after NCLT clearance
articles.summary: Coforge has completed the acquisition of Hyderabad-based Cigniti Technologies after receiving shareholder approval and clearance from the National Company Law Tribunal, fulfilling all regulatory requirements.

articles.title: Adani Group unveils sweeping overhaul to accelerate decisions and power next growth phase
articles.summary: Adani Group is streamlining its operations with a new three-layer structure. This move aims to accelerate decision-making and improve execution as India's infrastructure sector grows. The conglomerate is also expanding worker facilities and plans significant investments. Adani Enterprises is raising funds through a share sale. The group is addressing operational challenges and legal matters.

articles.title: Future Coupons to pay Rs 11 crore in Amazon settlement
articles.summary: Amazon and Future Coupons Pvt Ltd have settled their long-running dispute and agreed to withdraw all legal proceedings across forums following a March 13 agreement. Under the settlement, FCPL will pay over ₹11 crore, more than 10% of the ₹105 crore arbitration award, while also withdrawing its appeal against the Singapore arbitration ruling.

articles.title: Women gain ground in boardrooms, senior roles: Govt report
articles.summary: Women continue to break barriers in the corporate world, with a marked increase in their presence in senior roles. The statistics regarding female representation on boards and in leadership positions reveal a remarkable upward trajectory. Entrepreneurship, too, is witnessing an exciting surge with more women at the helm.

articles.title: Accenture leases 600,000 sq ft in Pune’s Baner for GCC
articles.summary: Accenture has secured a significant office space of over 600,000 sq ft in Pune. This new facility will house a global capability centre. The occupation will occur in two phases, concluding by June. This expansion is part of a larger strategy to enhance operational efficiency and consolidate teams.

articles.title: India BRICS Business summit aims to connect MSME sector globally
articles.summary: The India BRICS Business Summit in Hyderabad boosted India's MSME sector. The BRICS Entrepreneurs Alliance (BEA) India aims for global MSME unification. The Hyderabad Declaration outlines growth strategies. India will host the BEA Global Summit in November 2026. Dr. Bhaskar Jyoti Sonowal will lead the BEA Global Forum. This positions India for enhanced international trade and cooperation.

articles.title: Delhi High Court quashes Samir Modi's assault complaint against mother
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has dismissed a criminal complaint. Samir Modi withdrew his case against his mother, Bina Modi. This followed a settlement between them. The case involved an alleged assault on Samir Modi. He claimed he was physically assaulted while trying to attend a board meeting. The family has been involved in a legal dispute over their business empire.

articles.title: SC pushes mediation in Sunjay Kapur family estate dispute
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has urged Rani Kapur and Priya Kapur to resolve their dispute over the RK Family Trust through mediation. The court advised the 80-year-old Rani Kapur that prolonged litigation is unproductive. The trust holds a stake in Sona Comstar, a key company of the Sona Group.

articles.title: Tata Trusts may not recast trustee tenure amid ordinance
articles.summary: Tata Trusts, citing legal advice, may not revise existing trustees’ tenures despite a Maharashtra ordinance capping perpetual trustees. Experts differ on whether the rule applies retrospectively.

articles.title: FTA with New Zealand to boost India's export competitiveness, open growth avenues: India Inc
articles.summary: India and New Zealand have signed a free trade agreement. This pact offers Indian exporters zero-duty access to New Zealand's market. It opens doors for collaboration in advanced manufacturing, agritech, food processing, and digital technologies. Sectors like textiles, leather, and auto components will see enhanced competitiveness. The agreement aims to boost productivity and support small businesses.

articles.title: SC issues notice to Sunjay Kapur's wife Priya Kapur on plea by his mother over family Trust
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has asked for a response from Priya Kapur, wife of late industrialist Sunjay Kapur, and others. This follows a lawsuit filed by Sunjay's mother, Rani Kapur. She alleges the family trust was created using forged documents. The court suggested the parties explore mediation to resolve the dispute over the Sona Group Family Trust.

articles.title: Optimized Electrotech raises Rs 35 Crore in round led by Exfinity ventures to power its expansion into space-based imaging
articles.summary: Optimized Electrotech is moving into space-based sensing. The company is building a sovereign sensing stack for India. It has secured initial orders for a satellite platform. This expansion follows proven defence deployments. A recent funding round will accelerate satellite development and constellation infrastructure. Optimized Electrotech aims for persistent, real-time imaging and surveillance capabilities.

articles.title: Visa appoints Suresh Sethi as group country manager for India and South Asia
articles.summary: Visa has appointed Suresh Sethi as its new Group Country Manager for India and South Asia. Sethi will oversee Visa's strategy and operations across six countries. He previously led Protean e-Gov Technologies Ltd. Sethi's appointment marks a significant leadership change for Visa in the region. He will be based in Mumbai and report to Stephen Karpin.

articles.title: Start-up wave rises beyond metros as Patna emerges as an unlikely hub of innovation
articles.summary: Educated youth are now creating jobs in Patna, Bihar, instead of seeking them in metros. Initiatives like Start-up India are driving this change. Co-working spaces support young entrepreneurs. Startups in logistics, robotics, and home services are emerging. This trend signifies a transformation, with small cities becoming innovation hubs.

articles.title: Tata Elxsi says Gaurav Bajaj resigns as Chief Financial Officer; names Nalin Rana as successor
articles.summary: Tata Elxsi's Chief Financial Officer, Gaurav Bajaj, will resign on May 29, 2026. Nalin Rana will take over as the new CFO from May 30, 2026. Rana brings extensive experience in finance and strategy from his roles within the Tata Group and investment banking. This leadership change is in line with regulatory requirements.

articles.title: BSE revamps website: What has changed in the updated version? Check details
articles.summary: The BSE has launched its new website. It features a cleaner design and easier navigation. Users will find real-time market data more visible. Quick links and a search bar are now at the top. The navigation menu is reorganized for better access to market information. Live index data is prominently displayed.

articles.title: ET Awards: Groww CEO Lalit Keshre on building India’s largest stock broking platform and future growth plans
articles.summary: Groww, led by Lalit Keshre, has become India's top stock broking platform. The company recently saw its market capitalization surge significantly after a successful public listing. Groww achieved this growth by leveraging digital infrastructure and government databases. The company reported strong profits and substantial assets under management. Groww is now focusing on expanding its presence in the wealth management sector.

articles.title: ET Awards: Those who dare today will lead India in 2047, says Deloitte's Romal Shetty
articles.summary: Indians are embracing artificial intelligence personally at a rapid pace. However, companies are not deploying this technology strategically as quickly. This gap presents a significant risk to competitiveness. Leaders must make bold choices now to build future capabilities and embed technology for resilience. The nation's journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047 is a private sector mission.

articles.title: ET Awards: India Inc celebrates corporate excellence under luminous lotus in Mumbai
articles.summary: India's top business leaders gathered for the ET Awards in Mumbai. The event celebrated achievements and fostered conversation. Dignitaries like Nirmala Sitharaman and N Chandrababu Naidu attended. The evening highlighted India's economic vitality and the importance of peace for business success. Attendees enjoyed diverse culinary offerings and networking opportunities.

articles.title: ET Awards: ‘Invest in the idea of India, by India, for India,’ say top CEOs amid West Asia conflict
articles.summary: Indian business leaders view the West Asia conflict as a catalyst for long-delayed structural reforms, urging accelerated efforts in energy security and reduced external vulnerabilities. They advocate for greater self-reliance in energy sources and a significant push towards electric vehicles, while also emphasizing the need for workforce upskilling to navigate the disruptions brought by Artificial Intelligence.

articles.title: ET Awards: India Inc discusses strategy as FM Sitharaman signals readiness for reforms amid rising global uncertainty
articles.summary: India's finance minister has urged industry leaders to engage in open dialogue. Discussions at the Economic Times Awards focused on navigating global uncertainties. Experts proposed measures from wooing the diaspora to harnessing artificial intelligence. The nation is seen as well-positioned to manage disruptions, with a focus on domestic demand and future preparedness.

articles.title: Focus shifts to RIL's non-oil operations
articles.summary: Reliance Industries' March quarter results saw oil and gas businesses face pressure. Digital, telecom, and retail segments provided support. Investors will watch non-oil business performance for future earnings momentum. The company's new energy GIGA factory is set to become operational this year. Telecom ARPU saw a modest increase. Retail revenue grew, but Ebitda growth was limited.

ET Awards: Star power to light up the night; Finance Minister Sitharaman to  honour Chandrababu Naidu, India Inc
articles.summary: Mumbai's Jio World Convention Centre hosts the 26th Economic Times Awards for Corporate Excellence, celebrating India's economic leaders. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, a champion of reform, will be the chief guest. Andhra Pradesh CM N Chandrababu Naidu, recognized as Business Reformer of the Year, will also attend.

articles.title: Reliance Industries Q4 results key takeaways: O2C drags profit down 12.6% as Jio, retail hold the fort
articles.summary: Reliance Industries Limited saw its net profit fall 12.6 percent in the March quarter. This was due to challenges in its oil-to-chemicals segment. However, its consumer businesses like Jio Platforms and Reliance Retail performed well. For the full year, Reliance achieved record profits and revenue. The company announced a dividend of Rs 6 per share for FY26.

articles.title: IT firms refresh game as Gen Z employees move on faster
articles.summary: The Indian IT sector is currently witnessing a wave of replacement hiring, largely driven by the rapid job transitions of Gen Z workers. Unlike their predecessors, these young professionals are opting for shorter career stints, prompting companies to recalibrate their hiring, onboarding, and retention methodologies.

articles.title: Cognizant joins OpenAI partner group to scale Codex for enterprise clients
articles.summary: Cognizant is now a global partner of OpenAI. The company will use OpenAI's Codex technology to build software for its clients. This integration will speed up development and improve code quality. Cognizant engineers are already using Codex in client projects. The partnership aims to bring advanced AI capabilities to enterprise environments.

articles.title: Ex-Tesla India director Prashanth R Menon joins Venttup as strategic advisor
articles.summary: In a strategic move to accelerate its growth, Venttup, the Manufacturing-as-a-Service innovator, has welcomed Prashanth R. Menon as its advisory beacon. Having orchestrated Tesla's successful entry into India, Menon equips Venttup with invaluable expertise in scaling and strategy on a global landscape. His knowledge is perfectly poised to guide the company's mission of localizing essential components for the deep-tech sector.

articles.title: Godrej charts out new growth plan; eyes Rs 5 lakh crore market capitalisation by 2031
articles.summary: Godrej Industries Group aims for a ₹5 lakh crore market capitalization by 2031. The group plans to grow from three to five listed companies. Godrej Capital and its chemicals business are potential listing candidates. The strategy focuses on existing businesses for value creation. Over 15% annual sales growth and more than 20% earnings growth are targeted.

articles.title: NCLAT reserves order in Jaypee insolvency case; Vedanta alleges flawed evaluation, Adani defends bidding process
articles.summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal has reserved its judgment in the Jaypee insolvency case. Vedanta Group argued the resolution process lacked transparency and fair evaluation. The Resolution Professional defended the process, stating it followed approved frameworks. Adani Group, the declared winners, highlighted value enhancement through competitive bidding.

articles.title: Vedanta's plea indirectly challenges commercial wisdom of CoC: Adani to NCLAT
articles.summary: Adani Enterprises told NCLAT the Jaiprakash Associates resolution process followed due procedure, with evaluation metrics disclosed upfront and accepted by all bidders. It opposed Vedanta’s late addendum, saying it would undermine process integrity. Adani argued lender decisions reflect commercial wisdom, not subject to judicial review. The matter continues before the tribunal.
